response.sql:
WITH per_source AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux,
         AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_diff,
         AVG(s.aream2 / NULLIF(s.volm3, 0)) AS avg_area_to_volume
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
)
SELECT fundflux,
       avg_y_vs_x_diff,
       avg_area_to_volume,
       avg_area_to_volume - (SELECT AVG(avg_area_to_volume) FROM per_source) AS excess_over_cross_source_avg
FROM per_source
WHERE avg_area_to_volume > (SELECT AVG(avg_area_to_volume) FROM per_source);

assumptions.assumption: The Y-vs-X measure is computed per record as (boxy - boxx) / boxx, then averaged. Records with boxx = 0 or volm3 = 0 are treated as missing (NULLIF) rather than causing a division error, and NULLs are ignored by AVG.

The cross-source average is the unweighted mean of the per-funding-source area-to-volume averages. Only sources with at least one matching spatial record are included. A NULL fundflux, if present, is treated as its own group.
